below_min_firmware.description: hass-opnsense {version} requires OPNsense firmware {min_firmware} or later. Please upgrade OPNsense firmware to {min_firmware} or later. hass-opnsense will not start otherwise.

below_recommended_firmware.title: OPNsense Firmware below Recommended Version
below_recommended_firmware.description: Some hass-opnsense {version} functions require OPNsense firmware {recommended_firmware} or later. With firmware {firmware}, some functions may not work and there may be errors in the logs.

confirm.title: Reconcile replacement hardware inventory
confirm.description: This repair will reconcile {entry_title} with replacement Hardware ID {new_device_id}. Matching entities and devices retain their registry identity and customizations, entities absent from the replacement are removed, and new entities are created. Exception: if the service list or a firewall or NAT rule group cannot be read, its existing switches are kept and stay unavailable until you reload the integration after it can be read again. Kept switches with no match on the replacement are not removed automatically. A retry marker makes the repair resumable if interrupted. Dashboards and automations remain intact for preserved entity IDs; review references to removed entities. The previous Hardware ID was {old_device_id}.

abort.entry_not_found: The Firewall entry no longer exists.
abort.entry_changed: The Firewall entry changed while the repair was running. No registry changes were made.
abort.cannot_connect: The replacement hardware could not be confirmed. No changes were made.
abort.already_configured: Another Firewall entry already uses the replacement Hardware ID. No changes were made.
abort.cannot_unload: The Firewall entry could not be unloaded safely. No registry changes were made.
abort.repair_failed: The replacement hardware repair did not finish. Retry to resume reconciliation from the saved marker.
